prompt: Brooke put a hold on Alamo spend until we show her what May actually cost us on that recurring A/C issue and whether keeping the July 16th visit makes sense. I'm pretty sure we're just throwing money at repeat recharges instead of fixing the real problem. Can you look into what Alamo documented after I emailed their rep last week, figure out what May cost on that unit, and get Brooke what she needs so she can make the call? If that's the path forward, make sure our records and schedule reflect that, and loop in the team and the tenant so nobody's working off the old plan.
